data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"On clear, calm nights the urban canopy becomes a longwave radiation trap. Dense, tall building geometry narrows the sky view factor, so upward longwave emission from street-level surfaces is repeatedly intercepted and re-emitted by walls rather than escaping to space. The single best cross-city predictor of the nocturnal UHI magnitude is therefore mean building height / street-canyon density (a geometric sky-view index): cities with deeper canyons and lower sky view factors retain more of the stored daytime heat at night, producing a larger temperature gap.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If a city has very low building density (e.g., a sprawling, low-rise city), the sky view factor approaches that of the countryside and radiative trapping cannot explain a large UHI.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If wind speeds are high, turbulent mixing dominates over radiative trapping, eliminating the calm-night precondition and collapsing the gap.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If rural and urban sky view factors are similar (e.g., a city under a forest canopy or a rural area with dense windbreaks), the geometric difference vanishes and the explanation fails.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"During the day, urban surfaces (asphalt, masonry) with high thermal mass and heat capacity absorb solar radiation. After sunset, all surfaces cool by emitting longwave radiation skyward. In the countryside, an unobstructed sky view factor permits rapid radiative cooling. In the city, the 3D street-canyon geometry blocks a large fraction of the sky hemisphere; longwave photons emitted by the street are absorbed by building walls and re-emitted back downward, drastically slowing the nocturnal cooling rate. Cities with greater building height and built density have smaller sky view factors, trap more outgoing longwave radiation, and thus exhibit a larger night-time UHI.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
